answer: A newcomer climbs a public terrace of three steps, each step one useful job whose output feeds the next, forming a thread no clone can split; a different stranger re-runs each step live, staking 2 POA it was real. One failed step drops the thread to nadir — zero progress, bond slashed. The nth identity from one wallet climbs n terraces at once and posts 12n² POA (1st 12, 10th 1,200, 4,620 across ten); one operator cannot run ten live threads in one epoch, so fakes pay in real work and real strangers.
